choice_rule: Among passing cells maximize B_oracle - B_restart; exact ties prefer fewer A silent errors, then frozen cell order; if no cells pass, STOP.
episode_order: frozen cell order, then index 0..N-1 within each cell

execution_choices_G2.batching: PCS2b corrected runner pattern; source batch 32, receiver batch 24
execution_choices_G2.dtype: float16 on CUDA; float32 for CPU synthetic path
execution_choices_G2.source_token_cap: 8, enough for the two-digit answer and short enough to expose non-numeric output

families.F1: PCS1 pilot-v2 addition-only mod-10 chain, depths 1 and 2; original answer-exclusion constraint retained
families.F2: uniform integer operands in [10, 99], separately fixed + or ×, modulo 100
families.F3: random 10-entry digit map g:{0..9}->{0..9}, depth 1 asks g(d), depth 2 asks g(g(d))

post_handoff.m_selection: one deterministic uniform draw from 1..9 per episode; record partition per episode

receiver_prompts.B_oracle: chat(P + Intermediate result: v = A parsed answer + U + Answer with only the number), greedy, at most 4 new tokens
receiver_prompts.B_restart: chat(P + U + Answer with only the number), greedy, at most 4 new tokens
receiver_prompts.B_restart_reason: chat(P + U + permission to reason briefly + final integer instruction), greedy, 128-token descriptive cap
receiver_prompts.accuracy_target: true task answer (v_true + m) % base; also record whether B_oracle follows the A-implied answer
receiver_prompts.invalid_A_oracle: do not issue an oracle prompt; record missing prediction as incorrect in the N denominator

rng_derivation: random.Random(f'{seed}:RQ7:{cell_id}:{idx}:{purpose}'); F1 uses purpose program:<attempt>, F2/F3 use task; m is drawn from the same episode RNG

source_prompt.strict_parser: full response must match optional whitespace + decimal digits + optional whitespace; integer must be in [0, base)
source_prompt.user_content: P + newline + newline + Answer with only the number.

synthetic_response_policy: synthetic deterministic predictions only; not model or qualification evidence
